About the team Sarvam builds Indic-language AI used at population scale. The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through. The team builds and runs what it builds. Engineers own real systems end to end, and every repeated piece of manual work is a candidate for automation. As an AI company, we are building AI agents into our own operations, to plan and review infrastructure changes, triage alerts and handle routine issues, with engineers setting the guardrails. About the role You keep the infrastructure behind Sarvam’s products running. You handle day-to-day operations — deployments, provisioning, access, incidents and cost questions — and you are expected to automate that work away. We hire for one instinct above everything else: you notice something done by hand every day, ask why it can’t run itself, and build the thing that removes it — a script, a pipeline step, a bot, a small Kubernetes operator, or an AI agent that does the work. Operations is a large part of this role, and it is where you find what is worth automating. As you automate your own toil away, more of your time goes into platform and automation work. Products you may work on Sarvam builds across a broad range of AI products: voice agents, coding agents, coworker agents, dubbing, our API platform, and the real-time voice and WebRTC infrastructure underneath them, among many others. You will work on the infrastructure behind them. Responsibilities • Own infrastructure operations across Sarvam’s products: deployments, provisioning requests, access, environment issues, cost questions • Respond to incidents, write the runbook or postmortem afterwards, and fix the cause • Automate repeated work: turn manual steps into pipeline jobs, Terraform modules, templates or self-service for product teams • Build AI-assisted automations: agents that triage alerts, summarise incidents, review routine changes or answer product teams’ infrastructure questions, with a human approving anything risky • Security basics: keep images and dependencies patched, rotate credentials, keep secrets out of code, fix security findings • Reliability basics: keep dashboards and alerts accurate, track SLOs and cost, delete noisy alerts • Take part in on-call Requirements • 2–5 years in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or backend engineering • Has built infrastructure outside a ticket: a homelab, an open-source contribution, a side project, or an internal tool nobody asked for — and can show the code (GitHub, a blog post or a demo) • Comfortable on the Linux command line: processes, networking basics, logs, systemd • Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; has deployed and debugged something running on a cluster • Scripting in Python, Go or Bash • Basic Git and CI/CD experience • Has spotted a repeated manual task — a daily review, a recurring fix, a routine request — and built something that removed it: a script, a CI job, a bot or a Kubernetes operator. You can walk us through what you noticed, why it mattered, what you built and what it saved • Has used LLMs or AI agents to automate real work, not only for writing code • Fixes causes rather than the same symptom twice; asks “why is this manual?” before doing it again • Curious, takes ownership, wants to grow into platform engineering • Nice to have: Terraform, a public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), Prometheus / Grafana, exposure to SIP, WebRTC or real-time media, any cloud or Kubernetes certification

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our mission is to enable effective financial decisions through reliable data, increased efficiency, and automation. We support Marketing, Sales, Seller, Accounting, Tax, Finance and Strategy (F&S), Finance Operations (FinOps), and Treasury functions across automation, data insights, and process improvements.

You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including

Seller Systems — Responsible for building the systems and tooling that make sellers and internal revenue teams at Stripe dramatically more productive and effective. We partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to deliver a single "plane of glass" selling experience that spans deal creation and modeling, negotiation and approvals, contracting, onboarding, and activation. The Seller Systems team composes first‑party, custom Stripe components with best‑in‑class third‑party business systems to deliver configurable, auditable, and globally scalable workflows. Engineers on Seller Systems build services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and internal UIs that power seller productivity, reduce time‑to‑activation, improve deal velocity, and enable AI‑driven assistive workflows. Use cases include deal modeling and pricing engines, approval and orchestration platforms, CLM/CPQ integrations, onboarding automation, seller analytics, and AI‑assisted seller tooling.

Finance Engineering — Responsible for building the robust and scalable infrastructure that powers the company's core financial operations, including payments processing, fund settlement, accounting, and business intelligence. The Finance Engineering team is at the core of Stripe to empower business-critical financial domains including Accounting, Finance operations, Finance and Strategy, and Treasury. Engineers on the Financial Engineering team build platforms, data pipelines, and financial products for the Finance team. The use cases include financial analytics and insights, accounting automation, auditing, financial planning and forecasting, and financial business intelligence.

Marketing and Sales Systems — Responsible for building the most measurable, cross-channel messaging capability possible, to attract and engage customers. We do this through scalable motions, with the most relevant messaging and increasing reach of our marketing motions. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, analysts, marketers, and product managers that deliver the insights, internal systems and tools that fuel growth at Stripe.

As part of the Marketing Systems team, you own systems that power go-to-market motions productizing gathered insights and intelligence. This includes building tools that 1/ power better digital experiences, 2/ accelerate customer journey with intelligent orchestrations, 3/ drive smarter decisions with CDP, and 4/ improve marketer and seller productivity.

What you'll do

We're looking for Software Engineers who want to make an impact on managing money at a global scale with a passion for building ergonomic APIs. You'll play a key role in extending our balance management platform and in building out a new funds accessibility platform leveraged by enterprises and SMBs alike. Our team collaborates with many cross-functional teams — from Infrastructure to Product — at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain beautiful, robust, and high-performance APIs and services
  • Ensure our infrastructure is extensible, scalable, reliable, and meets service-level agreements for both external and internal users 
  • Hide complexity from our users behind simple yet powerful abstractions 
  • Partner closely with other engineers, analysts, and scientists to build highly scalable systems, to deliver delightful developer experiences and comprehensive interfaces 
  • Build the APIs that power internal stakeholder-facing UI experiences, defining composable data models and durable interfaces 
  • Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term 
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services 
  • You have implemented server-side APIs in dynamic languages like Ruby, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL) and enjoy spelunking through new datasets (especially in systems like Redshift, Presto, or Trino).
  • Empathetic, collaborative, and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
  • Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates, and subject matter experts
  • The skills to build holistically — from specs and documentation to implementation, testing, deployment, and measuring impact and ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale financial tracking systems 
  • Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud-based services (e.g. gRPC, GraphQL, Docker and Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.) 
  • Experience in marketing domain building products that contribute to marketing tech stack 
  • Experience with machine learning, recommender systems, product-led growth, or lifecycle marketing 
  • Prior experience building distributed systems or a microservices architecture

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

The Opportunity
We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our product engineering organization. In this role, you will help design, build, and scale features across our unified platform—from highly responsive React user interfaces down to core data processing backends built on Java and Python.This role is exceptional for an engineer looking to combine traditional full-stack development with cutting-edge AI-native engineering, specifically working with custom instrumentation agents and the emerging Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.
What You'll Do
● End-to-End Ownership: Feature delivery from UI wireframes to backend
implementation, database migrations, and production deployments.
● UI/UX Development: Build, maintain, and optimize elegant, data-dense web
experiences and custom charts/dashboards using React, JavaScript, and HTML.
● Scalable Backend Services: Write high-quality, production-ready backend logic utilizing
Java (Spring Boot) and Python for processing heavy telemetry workloads.
● Database Management: Model data for high-throughput, low-latency systems across
structured SQL and unstructured NoSQL databases.
● DevOps & Observability Culture: Actively leverage New Relic’s own platform to
monitor app health, troubleshoot production latency, and improve system reliability.
This Role Requires
● Experience: 3 + years of professional software engineering experience in a
collaborative, agile team environment.
● Front End Craftsmanship: Strong proficiency in React, vanilla JavaScript, and
HTML. Solid understanding of state management and modern CSS.
● Backend Skills: Deep hands-on experience in Java (JVM tuning and microservices
framework experience preferred) combined with professional exposure to Python for
scripts, data pipelines, or web services.
● Database Proficiency: Solid understanding of data modeling, schema design, and
query optimization (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis).
● Software Hygiene: Strong mastery of Git workflows, unit/integration testing (e.g., JUnit,
Jest, PyTest), and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Bonus Points (Added Advantages)
● Telemetry & Agent Development: Experience writing or customizing monitoring
agents, eBPF probes, or open-source collection daemons (like OpenTelemetry).
● AI Tools & MCP Servers: Experience developing or connecting to Model Context
Protocol (MCP) servers, creating developer tools, or designing custom AI agent
integrations to enhance engineering productivity.
● Distributed Systems: Familiarity with high-throughput messaging structures like
Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis.

About the Organization 

Payments is at the core of Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We are expanding our payments footprint in India and we are looking for Backend Engineers to own the technical architecture behind our next generation of payment offerings in India. 

As part of the India Payments team, you will build on top of Stripe’s robust foundational platforms, driving complex integrations and contributing to the architectural evolution of the critical services that handle money movement every millisecond. You will engineer the entire horizontal payments stack, driving every phase of a transaction's journey: integrating with local payment rails, managing initiation and intelligent routing, ensuring reliable completion and automating reconciliation and payouts. 

Partnering with cross-functional engineering hubs globally, you will tackle high-stakes technical challenges requiring low-latency execution, strict transactional idempotency, zero-downtime migrations and resilient distributed state management at scale.

If you thrive on taking ambiguous product mandates and turning them into fault-tolerant, self-healing distributed systems, you will feel right at home here.

What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)

  • Architect and operate low-latency, fault-tolerant backend microservices that integrate with Indian payment methods
  • Map complex, India-specific payment flows into Stripe’s global, unified API platforms, ensuring a seamless integration experience for developers worldwide
  • Design highly reliable adapter layers that interact with domestic banking partners and payment networks, building systems that gracefully handle external API latency and asynchronous callbacks
  • Own end-to-end service health, implementing shadow rollouts, distributed tracing, automated failovers and proactive alerting for 99.99% uptime
  • Collaborate with Product, Regulatory/Legal, Risk and Partner Integration teams across global engineering hubs while delivering seamless developer-facing APIs
  • Mentor and empower engineers to contribute independently through ongoing technical guidance and actionable feedback

Other Responsibilities

  • Independently scope, build and ship medium-to-large projects from ambiguous requirements to production
  • Build robust APIs that hide the extreme complexity of Indian payment rails behind simple, elegant developer experiences
  • Partner with product and data teams to proactively identify, size and solve the most impactful problems for our users
  • Engineer highly reliable, scalable infrastructure that consistently meets strict SLAs for all internal and external systems
  • Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes
  • Accelerate team velocity through high-quality code reviews and architectural collaboration

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services
  • You have implemented server-side APIs in languages like Ruby, Java, or Go, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL)
  • Empathetic, collaborative and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
  • Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates and subject matter experts
  • The ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs
  • Excellent oral and written communication

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building large-scale financial systems, payments infrastructure or working in the broader fintech industry is a plus
  • Experience building distributed systems or operating within a complex microservices architecture
  • Proficiency in Ruby, Java, or Go, with deep experience modeling data in relational and document databases (e.g., MySQL, Mongo)
  • Experience driving technical alignment across global, cross-functional teams

 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
